⚠️ This game is NOT AI generated. The name was recently changed from MOMMY to Mother.

【10/26/2026 - V 1.00.00 】
・Game Released

【 About 】
A strange noise wakes you from your sleep. You go to check on your baby sibling, only to discover someone disturbingly familiar lurking inside your home. Complete tasks, care for the baby, and find a way to save your family and yourself. Keep the baby quiet. Mother is never far away.

This game can be difficult for new players, do not be upset if you don't beat it the first try.

【 Recommendations】
⚠️ At least 60% graphics recommended
🤝 Joining with other players can be used to your advantage
🍼 Feed the baby to make sure it says quiet
🎧 Headphones recommended

❗ Join the group and community
🛠️ Game is still in early testing. Many things could change. Please report bugs.
